name: TCGA-STAD
role: Anchor development cohort and primary bulk audit
notes: Paper used n=348 after unspecified filtering; open expression and clinical fields are available but the exact analysis table is not supplied.

name: Ten GEO gastric bulk cohorts
role: Anchor bulk screening and validation candidates
notes: GSE62254, GSE15459, GSE57303, GSE29272, GSE84437, GSE14210, GSE34942, GSE13861, GSE26942, and GSE26253 exist publicly; paper-specific subsetting and endpoint mapping require reconstruction.

name: Four public gastric single-cell cohorts
notes: Sathe PMID 32060101 plus GSE167297, GSE163558, and GSE183904; processed data exist, but the anchor does not report a complete integration or patient-level inference specification.

name: HRA011727 in-house paired single-cell cohort
notes: Controlled access as of 2026-08-02; official description discusses GREM1+ fibroblasts and SPP1+ macrophages rather than the paper's NRRS analysis, creating a provenance inconsistency that must be resolved with the depositor.

name: PRJEB25780 metastatic gastric cancer pembrolizumab cohort
notes: Public study; it is a PD-1 pembrolizumab cohort, not a PD-L1 cohort as stated in the anchor; no untreated comparator supports a treatment-interaction claim.

name: IMvigor210 urothelial cancer cohort
notes: Atezolizumab-treated urothelial cancer is not gastric cancer; association after cross-cancer transfer cannot establish gastric treatment prediction.

name: GSE251950 gastric spatial transcriptomics
notes: GEO reports nine primary gastric cancer patients and ten Visium profiles because GC6 has paired primary and metastatic samples; G1 must verify neural marker capture, patient metadata, tissue regions, and overlap before use.

name: GSE308624 gastric CosMx spatial cohort
notes: Public from 2025 with 71 sections and 200182 cells; panel coverage, clinical metadata, compute burden, and independence need G1 verification.

name: GSE183904 gastric single-cell atlas
notes: Public processed single-cell data; raw files were not submitted for privacy, and spatial GeoMx measurements described by the source paper need separate access verification.

name: TRIPOD external-validation and reporting framework
notes: Requires applying the original formula to new participants and evaluating model performance; discrimination and calibration are distinct.

name: PROBAST prediction-model risk-of-bias framework
notes: Use participant, predictor, outcome, and analysis domains; do not equate many cohorts with low risk of bias.

name: Exact anchor analysis code
notes: No code-availability statement or repository was found in the paper, supplement, or targeted DOI/title/accession searches as of 2026-08-02.

name: survival package and vignettes
notes: Official maintained implementation fragment; final versions and model diagnostics must be frozen in G2.

name: glmnet package and vignette
notes: High-quality method donor, but it cannot recover the anchor's undocumented folds, seed, preprocessing, or cutoff.

name: muscat Bioconductor workflow
notes: Use for patient-level pseudobulk or differential-state patterns when count and design requirements are met; do not treat cells as biological replicates.

name: Seurat official vignettes
notes: Useful modular donor for object handling and visualization; paper-specific adapters and tests remain necessary.

name: SpatialExperiment Bioconductor infrastructure
notes: Use as a stable container and provenance layer; analysis method still depends on platform and biological question.

name: Published 441 nerve-related gene list
notes: The list is present, but KEGG pathway IDs, database version, retrieval date, inclusion logic, and deduplication rules are absent.

name: R 4.4.1 server environment
notes: Credentials are never stored in Git; package lock, system libraries, and smoke tests are deferred until a direction is approved.

name: GSE214293 paired gastric tumor and adjacent-tissue expression cohort
role: Published PNI-inflammation model provenance and comparison donor
notes: Fifty samples form paired tumor and adjacent-tissue records from the published PNI-mediated inflammation study; this is provenance evidence, not an independent rediscovery cohort.

name: GSE62254 gastric cancer cohort
notes: Three hundred gastric tumors are public; G1 must verify the exact pathological PNI field, coding, missingness, expression preprocessing, survival fields, and independence from any score-development step.

name: Squidpy official documentation and examples
notes: Use only multi-sample graph, neighborhood, and image-integration fragments that preserve patient and section identities; examples are not a substitute for a prespecified inferential model.

name: TIAToolbox whole-slide image toolkit
notes: Maintained pathology toolkit for slide reading, patching, and models; the high-burden multimodal reserve still needs pathology labels, patient-level splits, tests, and an external cohort.

notes: Generated under schema v0.2.0 on 2026-08-02; owner approval is still required before G1.
